This is a great comment. It’s really a lot of work. I grow mine entirely without automation. In October 2018 I was at 400 followers, by New Years I was at 1100. Now I’m sitting at 3450 or so. 

Whenever people in my life make comments about you’re “an influencer now!!” (I’m not””, and ask me for tips, I really tell them that I spend a lot of time on the platform engaging with followers and potential new followers. That, and a crazy amount of patience and grind. 

Good content is king though. I edit all of mine before they go live and won’t post any photo that’s just okay. I’d rather not post than post a mediocre shot.
